suggested_experiment_name: Axions, Instantons and the Lattice (axion relic density, post-inflationary)
coupling_convention: Omega (axion relic density fraction), dimensionless — the plotted y-axis quantity. NOTE: this is a relic-density band, not a coupling; x-axis is axion mass m_a in eV (converted from micro-eV), not f_a.
notes: Theoretical paper reassessing uncertainties in the temperature-dependent topological susceptibility chi(T) and its impact on the axion relic density / zero-temperature axion mass. It provides relic-density formulas and mass-vs-misalignment-angle plots, but presents NO experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on any coupling. The main result is a factor of 2-3 theoretical uncertainty in the axion mass for a given relic density; not an f_a-m_a exclusion bound.
